profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 8 years of experience building and scaling web applications, now focused on data engineering and cloud-native architectures. I design and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark and AWS services such as Glue, Redshift, Lambda, and S3, with a strong emphasis on data modeling, data quality, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation). I bring solid software-engineering practices—testing, CI/CD, and scalable design—into modern data platforms to deliver production-ready insights. Passionate about bridging software development and data engineering to help teams turn raw data into actionable intelligence.
